card.title: PS4 No Display - White Light Of Death (WLOD) Causes and HDMI Circuit Troubleshooting

source.title: PlayStation 4 HDMI Encoder and Filter Location

claims.statement: Check hard drive this can cause BLOD or no display, check the drive by testing and connecting it to a pc.
Bad HDMI Connector can cause WLOD

claims.evidence: Text in cause table and image pointing to filters with 'Check continuity filters'

claims.statement: Check diodes and capacitors near the HDMI circuit
Most common fault is a bad HDMI encoder IC is bad most of the time you can't measure any faults by reading diode measurements
claims.evidence: Text in cause table and image pointing to Panasonic MN864729 with 'HDMI Encoder Is faulty most of the time when there is no picture'

claims.statement: Check status led it could be broken, check for damage led or components
Check if the solder near the HDMI filters are not making a connection with the filters or components. This happens when you remove the shield with hot air.
If you replaced encoder IC and still you get a WLOD replace encoder IC again it could be broken from factory.

card.caveats: The image provides troubleshooting steps and component identification for the HDMI section but does not contain explicit voltage or diode measurement values.
